title: DROPSHAWTY DRUMKITS - SOUNDS FOR TRAP METAL, AFOURTEEN, LIL DARKIE, NASCAR ALOE, TRIPLESIXDELETE, ETC.
Cryptid Radio — dark lo-fi / boom bap kit (89 one-shots + 48 loops). Every sound synthesized from scratch, nothing sampled.
description:
Shortwave numbers station meets Pacific Northwest forest. Drum breaks dusted in fog, half-tuned keys, and a voice reading numbers to nobody.

Every sound in it came out of synths and sequencers I built myself. No recordings, no samples, no flips — nothing in here to clear. The voice one-shots run through a formant synthesizer, which is why the announcer sounds like a machine reading. That was the point.
